name: Margarita
desc: Blanco tequila, Cointreau and fresh lime juice shaken and served on the rocks with a salt rim.

source.title: The Original Margarita
source.evidence: Same three ingredients with Cointreau as the only sweetener, a salt rim, and shaken over ice into a rocks glass; the ratios are close (5:3:2 there, 6:4:3 here).

ingredients.raw: 2 tbsp coarse kosher salt, for the rims

steps: Spread the salt on a small plate. Rub the lime wedge around the rims of 2 rocks glasses, dip them in the salt, and fill the glasses with fresh ice.
Fill a shaker with ice and add the tequila, Cointreau and lime juice.
Shake hard until the outside of the shaker is frosty, 10 to 15 seconds.
Strain over the fresh ice, dividing between the 2 glasses.
tips: Love and Lemons and Well Seasoned Studio use as much lime as tequila plus 1/2 oz agave; if this one tastes too strong, add a squeeze more lime and a little agave.
